title: Chapter 940
text:
Flames soared into the sky, and chaos spread throughout Enya Hub. A series of explosions occurred in different regions, and it was as though someone had detonated a high-energy bomb.

After receiving the message from his comrades, Raymond rushed over to meet up with them. Fu Ding and Aurora could only follow along, and he secretly informed the other Black Star Guards along the way.

Because he had to infiltrate the Punisher Alliance, it was not convenient for him to make a move, and the Black Star Guards were the best helpers.

The current situation had already exceeded their initial expectations, and in order to stop this sudden storm, the Black Star Corps could not stand by and do nothing.

When they arrived at the military restricted zone, it had become a chaotic battlefield. Garrison battleships gathered from all directions. Worried about the damage to the city caused by the aftermath, they could only use planetary weapons to attack the enemies on the ground.

Enya's guardian, Jabra, led a group of subordinates to fight against the gray organizations. He also had Calamity Grade Supers by his side, and there were already seven to eight Calamity Grade Supers fighting in the area. The shockwaves caused by the battle caused the entire area to change beyond recognition. The garrison quickly activated the protective shield of the city to prevent the shockwaves from spreading to other areas.

The members of the Punisher Alliance were unable to interfere in a battle between Calamity Grade Supers, and they could only help deal with the gray organizations. The battle was also extremely intense.

"Quick, go and help!" The moment he arrived, Raymond joined the battle without hesitation.

Seeing this, Feidin protected Aurora and only displayed the strength of a Grade B. He was able to deal with the minions with ease. As he fought, he diverted his attention to consider the situation.

I never expected that things would develop in such a manner. There must be an unknown power behind these gray organizations for them to join forces to snatch the Evolutionary Totem.

Fu Ding frowned and thought to himself, Instead of spending so much effort to snatch the Evolutionary Totem from the dynasty, they might as well snatch the allied civilizations of the other Star Fields. They shouldn't be taking such a huge risk just for the Evolutionary Totem.

Just as he was thinking, another round of explosions occurred in the various regions. Clearly, there were still enemies in the dark, causing chaos everywhere.

Jabra dodged the heavy hammer of the Blood Hammer Bishop and turned around to look at the chaotic scene in the distance. He was instantly enraged and roared, "Send some people to maintain law and order. Get rid of those bastards who are causing explosions everywhere!"

After the order was given, a portion of the warships dispersed and headed to various districts to maintain order.

Rumble!

At this time, a huge explosion occurred in a distant city. A tall building collapsed, and the shockwave shattered the streets. Another unknown Calamity Grade aura appeared.

"There are more enemies?!" Jabra glanced at them angrily, thinking that they were reinforcements.

However, the Calamity Grade in the distance had no intention of approaching. Instead, he started fighting with someone.

"What's the situation?" Jabra was puzzled, but he could not leave. From his point of view, the enemy's target was the Evolutionary Totem. If he left, the enemy would break through the defense line and snatch the Evolutionary Totem. He could not leave his post.

After thinking about it, Jabra could only temporarily ignore the unknown situation in the distance and quickly get rid of this group of Calamity Grade Supers in front of him. Only then would he have time to deal with the situation in the distance.

Fu Ding had also sensed the shockwaves in the distance. When he turned around to take a look, his pupils shrank.

If he did not remember wrongly, that seemed to be the direction he had come from. In an instant, Fu Ding thought of the group of Calamity Grade Supers that he had discovered. Just based on his intuition, he could guess that they were fighting with the bodyguards of the dynasty's high officials.

"This seems to be the same scheme …" Fu Ding had a flash of inspiration.

…

At the same time, an intense battle was going on in another city. The Calamity Grade Supers did not hold back at all, and the shockwaves from the collision caused a large number of tall buildings to collapse.

The two parties involved in the battle were the four Calamity Grade Supers and the two bodyguards of Ludwell's grandson.

Four against two, the ordinary bodyguards of Ludwell's grandson were all dead. Only the two Calamity Grade Supers were left, and they were bitterly enduring the attacks of the four Calamity Grade Supers.

"Who … who is it that wants to attack me?" Ludwell's grandson's face was filled with panic. Although he was the son of a high official, he had chosen not to develop in the dynasty's political circle. Instead, he had chosen to become a businessman. He had never imagined that he would receive such treatment one day.

At this moment, he was protected within a temporary energy shield and was unable to move. Outside the shield, there were shockwaves that were enough to crush him. He would lose his life the moment he stepped out.

His two bodyguards were high-level combatants nurtured by the dynasty and were loyal to their duty. Although they knew that they were at a disadvantage, they gritted their teeth and resisted the attacks of the four.

Bang!

All of a sudden, one of the bodyguards suffered a heavy blow and spat out a mouthful of blood. He was sent flying through more than ten tall buildings and flew far away.

The remaining bodyguard suffered from the focus fire, and his injuries rapidly worsened. After all, they were not elite Calamity Grade Supers like Jabra, and this group of Calamity Grade Supers was not simple either. With a single opening, the arm of this bodyguard was chopped off by one of the Calamity Grade Supers, and fresh blood spurted out.

This person's face turned pale, but he only let out a groan. He gritted his teeth and wanted to retaliate, but his resolute personality did not increase his combat strength. His body suffered continuous attacks, and blood spurted out from his body as he moved through the air. His face turned paler, and his aura rapidly declined.

The two bodyguards were heavily injured, and Ludwell's grandson had lost the protection of his experts. He was like a lamb waiting to be slaughtered, exposed to the sharp claws of the four enemies.

"Kill him!" The four of them were overjoyed and were about to work together to kill their target.

However, the next moment, a change occurred.

Beams of light suddenly descended from the sky and headed toward them. The word 'danger' seemed to appear above the heads of the Calamity Grade Supers, and they hurriedly scattered in all directions.

Rumble!

The beams of light landed in front of them, and the ground shattered. The soil was instantly crystallized by the high temperature.

Following the explosions, a few figures descended, and their bodies emitted powerful Calamity Grade energy waves as they blocked in front of the four Calamity Grade Supers.

"Who are you people?" One of them immediately felt that something was amiss. This group of Calamity Grade Supers that had suddenly appeared were not from the intelligence reports and were not the guards of Enya Hub. Furthermore, the pressure that they gave off was far greater than the two bodyguards they had just faced. They were definitely at the upper echelons of the Calamity Grade Supers.

"We are the Black Star Guards of the Black Star Corps. Who are you people? How dare you cause trouble in the dynasty's territory? "Hardaway looked at the group of Calamity Grade Supers coldly.

The few Calamity Grade Supers were stunned, and their expressions changed drastically!

Black Star Corps?

When did they come to Enya Hub? Why didn't we receive any news at all?

Sh * t, we've bumped into a gun this time!

The few of them felt bitter. If they had known that the Black Star Corps was here, they would not have dared to participate in this plan.

Damn it, we actually bumped into them. Damn it, we're really bloody unlucky!

"There are actually reinforcements!" On the other hand, the two heavily injured bodyguards were overjoyed and heaved a sigh of relief.

Thankfully, His Excellency Black Star was in Enya Hub. If not, the outcome would have been disastrous!

The moment the name of the Black Star Corps was announced, the four Calamity Grade Supers wanted to retreat and give up on the mission. However, Hardaway would not give them any time to think. He charged forward with the Black Star Guards, and the two sides instantly engaged in a fierce battle.

…

On the other side, the battle in the military region had already reached its climax. Countless people were blasted into dust, and one Calamity Grade Supers even had his head crushed by Jabra.

However, although the troops in Enya Hub had the upper hand, Jabra would not be able to deal with all the enemies in a short time. The chaos in Enya Hub would not be quelled in a short time.

The members of the Punisher Alliance were helping out in one of the battlefields. After an intense battle, many of them had suffered varying degrees of injuries.

At this time, they finally experienced the healing ability of Aurora. No matter how severe their injuries were, they would be able to recover in a single breath. Everyone was instantly energized, and without any worries, they started to attack ferociously without fear of death.

Even Slade, who was wary of the two of them, felt really good at this time. When he was receiving treatment, he kept a straight face and was too embarrassed to say thank you.

Aurora's Esper Ability had grown for such a long time, and the recovery speed of her life force was much faster than before. The small amount of life force consumed to heal a Grade B Super was not even comparable to her own recovery speed.

While the battle was going on, the projection of an adjutant suddenly appeared beside Jabra. He was sweating profusely and said in panic, "Your Excellency Jabra, the Evolutionary Totem is gone!"

"What!" Jabra was shocked, and he roared in anger, "How did you lose it? Find it for me!"

At this moment, how could he not understand that the enemy was using a diversion tactic to lure the tiger away from the mountain? The attack from the outside was just a feint, and there were still thieves secretly sneaking in to steal the Evolutionary Totem while the garrison was being held back by this group of gray organizations.

The Evolutionary Totem was stored in a heavily guarded place, but the reason galactic thieves had a business was because they could sneak into places where ordinary people could not enter and steal precious items.

With the situation developing to this point, even with Jabra's arrogance, he could not help but be surprised by the number of forces the enemy had mobilized. He was curious as to who had organized this scheme.

Spending so much effort just for a single totem? Jabra did not think that was the case.

Protecting the totem was his responsibility, and he did not place much importance on the totem itself. After all, they were also allies of the dynasty and could purchase a new totem from the Black Star Corps at any time.

While he was thinking, the enemy Calamity Grade Supers launched a fierce attack on him, interrupting his train of thought. Jabra could lose the totem, but these people had to die.

"Let's get rid of these troublemakers first before dealing with the stolen totem."

However, just as this thought flashed through his mind, a few Calamity Grade Supers descended from the sky. It was the other Black Star Guards, and they joined the battle without saying a word. With this group of fresh troops, the situation was instantly reversed, and the stalemate was broken.

"Reinforcements?" Jabra was stunned. Where did these people come from?

One of the Black Star Guards worked together with him to shatter the High Dimensional Magic Entity summoned by the Blood Hammer Bishop. Making use of this opportunity, Jabra grabbed this Black Star Guard and asked,

"Who are you guys?"

The Black Star Guards glanced at him and said, "Black Star Guards."

"It's you guys!" Jabra was overjoyed. He knew that Black Star had been running around the dynasty recently, but he did not expect him to come to his territory.

The heavens are really helping me!

Without saying a word, Jabra roared, and his voice swept across the entire battlefield.

"The Black Star Corps reinforcements have arrived. If you don't want to die, stop resisting!"

The Black Star Guards all looked over.

We haven't even reported our names, and you're already starting? Why do you look more like a Black Star Guard than us?

However, the moment these words came out, the effect was immediate.

The faces of all the enemy members present changed drastically. Everyone knew of Black Star's reputation, and their hearts sank to the bottom of the abyss!

On the other hand, the morale of the troops in Enya Hub was greatly boosted!

The moment they thought of the dynasty's Beyond Grade A standing behind them, they felt more at ease.

To the dynasty's soldiers, the dynasty's Beyond Grade As were their spiritual pillars on the battlefield.

"Black Star Corps …" The members of the Punisher Alliance looked at the Black Star Guards on the battlefield with a strange look in their eyes.

Such an organization that could dominate the universe was an unreachable existence in their eyes. It was not something they could come into contact with.

Seeing the famous Black Star Guards of the Black Star Corps, everyone was excited as though they had seen their idols. To the Supers, such a famous Calamity Grade group was no different from the idols of the Supers.

…

"We've got it. Let's go!"

At the same time, in another region, a few bandits wearing anti-detection stealth suits escaped with the Evolutionary Totem and left the battlefield.

They had followed the plan and snuck into the secret facility to steal the Evolutionary Totem while the troops in Enya Hub were busy. As a famous galactic bandit in the black market, not only did they have all sorts of high-tech equipment, but they also had special Esper Abilities. Before they were discovered, they had managed to steal the Evolutionary Totem.

Spaceships flew past in the sky, searching for traces of the bandits. This group of bandits had been hiding all over the place to avoid being caught.

Just as they were about to run out of an alley, they suddenly felt a weight on their shoulders, and they were pinned to the ground by a huge force.

A faint breathing sound appeared behind them out of thin air. Before this, they had not noticed it at all, and their hair stood on end.

They turned their heads stiffly and saw two arms grabbing their shoulders. A handsome face gradually appeared from the shadows.

"Where are you guys going with the goods I sold?"

His tone was very calm, but it was like thunder in their ears!

This face could be said to be a household name in the universe. Perhaps ordinary people would not recognize it, but every organization with a name would definitely recognize who the owner of this face was.

The dynasty's Beyond Grade A ally, 'Indestructible Body', 'Enemy of Ethereal', 'Lord of Evolution', and 'Lord' — Black Star!

The bodies of the galactic bandits froze, and they did not dare to move.

Han Xiao snorted, and nanoparticles flowed out from his clothes, turning into a restraining device that restrained the few of them. He then waved his hand, and a mechanical soldier walked out from the void and appeared beside him.

"Return the items to where they came from." Han Xiao pointed at the Evolutionary Totem.

When the chaos had just erupted, Han Xiao, who had been training his energy in seclusion, had already noticed the situation. He had tacitly allowed the Black Star Guards to take action to stop this storm, and he had also noticed when the Evolutionary Totem was stolen.

After such a long period of practice, Han Xiao had already established a Soul Connection with the Evolution Cube according to the information left behind by the Evolutionary Civilization. The effect was similar to Sisko's, and he could sense the location of the Evolution Cube.

Not only that, as long as he was within a certain distance, he would be able to sense the Evolutionary Totem. To be precise, he would be able to sense the evolution energy contained within the Evolutionary Totem.

In a battle between Calamity Grade Supers, there was no need for him to take action. The Black Star Guards under him were more than enough to deal with this group of enemies. However, since the Evolutionary Totem was stolen, he could not just stand by and watch. Thus, he directly teleported from the spaceship to the back of this group of bandits.

With the intervention of the Black Star Corps, this chaos would be suppressed very quickly. When this group of people was scheming, they definitely did not think that he would appear there.

Watching the mechanical soldiers return with the Evolutionary Totem, Han Xiao retracted his gaze and looked at the group of bandits he had captured. A meaningful smile appeared on his face.

"Now … tell me everything you know."
